description: Turn websites into standalone desktop apps with a graphical interface.
notes: Use Scoop to update Pake; its in-app updater can update this Scoop-managed installation outside Scoop. Apps created with Pake are stored separately under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Pake Apps and remain after Pake is uninstalled. Pake also keeps its license and gallery cache under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Pake. Apps made with Pake require Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime; Windows 11 includes it.
